title: Repeat Extension of the Listing Expiry Period, Seller Performance Standing
content:
Sellers with repeated violations wait longer for listing policy and restricted product violations to expire.

**Extension.** The repeat extension adds the three-violation extension of 2 whole calendar months to the listing expiry period when the repeat count is three or more, the two-violation extension of 1 whole calendar month when it is two, and nothing when it is lower. The repeat count is taken over the last twelve whole calendar months, and the extended period applies to both listing types alike.

Under Seller Performance Standing whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a violation lies in the last twelve whole calendar months when fewer than twelve whole months have passed from its recording date to the handling date.

## Schedule

| Repeat count over the last twelve whole calendar months | Months added to the listing expiry period |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 0 or 1 | none |

## Both sides of each step

- A repeat count of exactly 3 adds 2 months; a count of 2 adds 1 month.
- A count of 1 adds nothing; a count of 4 adds 2 months, the same as 3.
- **Hypothetical period.** A listing expiry period starting from 5 months with a repeat count of 2 runs to 6 months; with a repeat count of 3 it runs to 7 months.
